"''Remember what Porkins said? Sometimes you have to sacrifice to win the hand…!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Cesi Eirriss|Cesi "Doc" Eirriss]]|}} A '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] was undertaken by [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to collect a cargo of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. ==Prelude== [[File:Porkins4.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Porkins]] takes exception to a remark about his size.]] Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Red Squadron pilots went to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Commenor to collect a dozen of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] for the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Strike at an Incom Corporation facility|collected]] eatlier. Their contact was the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nera Dantels]]. Before the meeting, the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] were lazing in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] when they were attacked by a band of thugs. After a short street fight, the villains fled and went to denounce the Rebels to [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. ==The mission== The Rebels finally met with Captain Dantels in [[Hangar Bay 31]] and examined the cargo of astromechs. After confirming the cargo, they arranged to meet up with her in orbit and escort the ''[[Starduster]]'' back to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. [[File:Mission_to_Commenor.png|thumb|left|200px|The Rebels and ''Starduster'' intercepted trying to depart Commenor.]] Nevertheless, they were intercepted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] coming from the [[Folor Base (Imperial)|Imperial base]] on the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Folor]]. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Antilles]] and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Darklighter]] broke formation to intercept, leaving [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Porkins]] and [[Cesi Eirriss|Eirriss]] to provide cover for the ''Starduster''. However, some TIEs made it through and were able to get on Porkins's tail. Eirriss eliminated his pursuers and Porkins soon reciprocated, but more TIEs came and attacked the ''Starduster''. Though Dantels was able to shoot them off, some of the debris struck Eirriss's X-wing, damaging her [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. With no time to eject before the next wave of TIEs arrived, and no way to leave the system, Eirriss set a collision course for the incoming fighters, telling her comrades to leave without her. Her X-wing was destroyed in a head-on collision with the Imperial fighters. Porkins, Antilles, and Darklighter eventually jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Doc's gone, and there's nothing we can do about that…but we can send the Death Star to hell in her name!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|}} After landing in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], they learned that the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was already en route to Yavin to destroy the Rebel base. They also met Darklighter's old friend, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had himself just arrived on Yavin 4 and was to join Red Squadron for the upcoming [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. ==Appearances== *[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]] {{1st}} *[[Empire 12|''Empire'' 12]] {{Flash}} *[[Empire 15|''Empire'' 15]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' *{{FactFile|24|DAR 1-4|Biggs Darklighter}} *{{FactFile|88|COM 1-2|Commenor}} *{{FactFile|126|NER 1-2|Captain Nera Dantels}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{GCW 0 BBY}} {{Interlang |es=Misión a Commenor (Guerra Civil Galáctica) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Commenor (0 BBY), mission to}} [[Category:Battles of Commenor]] [[Category:Missions of the Galactic Civil War]]
